description: List enabled public churches in stable camera ID order, up to 50 per page. Pass next_cursor as cursor with the same query to continue; null means the end. truncated indicates more matching records. Optional literal name/address substring filter. Use camera_id for church profiles or sermon filters. Each page consumes the shared listing allowance. This is a live catalog, not a snapshot; additions before the cursor require restarting traversal.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page. Bound to the same query.

limit.description: Maximum number of churches to return (default 20, maximum 50).

query.description: Optional literal substring of a church name or address. Preserve Polish diacritics; case folding is limited to ASCII letters. Keep the same query on subsequent pages.

name: list_churches
title: Find public churches
